description: List every US-listed stock and ETF Cestrian Capital Research covers, each with its current rating (Accumulate, Hold, Distribute, Stop or Do Nothing) and the as-of date. Optionally filter by sector or by rating. Use this to answer "does Cestrian cover X", "what does Cestrian rate Accumulate" or to see the whole book.

rating.description: Optional. Return only names with this rating.

sector.description: Optional. One of the sector names returned in "sectors", e.g. "Tech", "BioTech", "ETFs".
